content:
The image shows a banana leaf with:
- A broad yellow/chlorotic band running along the leaf margin
- Dark brown to black necrotic tissue at the very edge
- Streak-like lesions running parallel to the leaf veins, extending from the necrotic margin into the yellowed zone
- The upper portion of the leaf remains green

This pattern (chlorotic streaks and necrotic lesions on banana leaves, progressing from margin inward) is the hallmark of Sigatoka diseases. It does not match Panama Disease, which involves internal vascular discoloration, pseudostem splitting, and whole-plant wilting rather than leaf streaks.
